checklist.criterion: Entry point and output directory set correctly: `entryPoints` includes `src/index.ts` and `out` (or equivalent) is `docs/`
Internal/private members are excluded: The config sets an option (e.g. `excludePrivate`, `excludeInternal`, `excludeNotDocumented`) so only the re-exported public API is documented
Output format is chosen and justified: `docs-setup.md` names a specific format suited to being committed and browsed statically (e.g. HTML) and explains why
Exact run command documented: `docs-setup.md` states the exact command to generate the docs (e.g. `npx typedoc`)
Post-generation verification steps listed: `docs-setup.md` lists concrete things to check in the output (both exports present, no leaked internal API), not just "check it looks right"
